name: aio-claude-toolkit
description: Claude Code management toolkit — skill management, plugin install, session reflection, memory consolidation, skill capture, and feedback. Six skills: aio-claude-manager (enable/disable/preset skills), aio-install (install aiocean plugins), aio-reflect (extract session learnings), aio-dream (consolidate memories), aio-skillify (capture workflows as skills), feedback (submit bug reports/feature requests).
